title: Independent Three-Arm Pedagogical Quality Evaluation / Blind Protocol

anchors.5: exceptionally clear with no material flaw

reviewer_protocol.missingness: DO_NOT_IMPUTE; unrated clips block completeness and gate
reviewer_protocol.timestamped_failure_notes: Mandatory if any criterion <=2 or apparent misleading early reveal; otherwise optional
reviewer_protocol.watch_order: Per-reviewer predetermined case order and A/B/C cyclic rotation; blinded condition labels; may replay and record replay
reviewer_protocol.independence: External humans, distinct consented reviewers; pseudonyms; host must separately check eligibility and conflicts; metadata cannot prove independence
reviewer_protocol.rating_lock: Review scores SHA-256 and receipt created BEFORE opening admin mapping; never transmit admin mapping to reviewers

analysis.primary: Per-reviewer-within-topic paired change in causal_witness score of causal_reveal minus original_motion; separately versus static_end_state
analysis.estimand: Descriptive ordinal median of paired differences per topic and across reviewer-topic units; no significance claim with n=3
analysis.reporting: Report all 3 topic deltas, individual blinded ratings, missingness and disagreement; no pooled independent n=9 inference, no p values
analysis.human_educational_effect: NOT_MEASURED; reviewer scores are not learner performance

validity_threats: V3-58 static arm advances result reveal as well as removing motion; not pure motion-only counterfactual
Raters can infer which version has motion; single-blind condition labels, not double-blind
Three raters and three hand-picked synthetic topics cannot establish population generalization
Same narration / AAC does not prove word-level speech/visual alignment
Technical native/pixel validation cannot substitute for human comprehension
Automatic code gate cannot authenticate human independence without host attestations
